subject: Fixing debug mode compilation failure related to simsimd (#1223)
reason: The change only adds `static` to three `inline` SIMD helper functions in vendored simsimd headers to fix a debug-mode (-O0) compilation/linkage failure. It changes symbol linkage, not any function body: distance and log2 computations, and thus all module commands and replies, are identical on both builds. This is a build fix with no runtime behaviour change, so there is nothing a scenario could observe.
